_comment: Wrapper-backed capacity that emits a fire-and-forget intention to another context.

objective.name: sandbox.emit.fire
objective.description: Emit a fire-and-forget outbound intention through the wrapper runtime

#root.role: Emit an outbound intention to another context without waiting and return a local acknowledgement.

effects.outbound_route: The wrapper emits a fire-and-forget outbound intention.

transformation_contract.morphing: A local wrapper request becomes a fire-and-forget outbound intention plus an immediate local acknowledgement.
invariants: sandbox.emit.fire must remain bounded by its declared inputs, outputs, and effects.
Internal implementation strategy may vary, but the declared contract surface must remain stable.
success: sandbox.emit.fire returns payload and matter effects consistent with the declared outputs when it succeeds.
Successful execution preserves the semantic change described by morphing.
failure: sandbox.emit.fire fails when required inputs or matter contracts are not satisfied.
The capacity fails when the underlying runtime or wrapper cannot satisfy the declared contract.
notes: This contract constrains expected behavior and observable effects, not the internal implementation decomposition.
Humans and LLMs should interpret the capacity through the declared interface and semantic guarantees first.
